deferred.reason: Generic UI/support and unused pages were not all fully source-audited.
No Docker runtime or authorized hosted HTTPS deployment was available for runtime verification.

explicitExclusions.reason: Dependency source not exhaustively reviewed; registry advisory audit performed separately.

openQuestions.question: Verify deployment through the actual HTTPS reverse proxy before admitting testers.
Complete a broader source security review of unused UI/support code before expanding Beta scope.

resolvedDeferred.reason: All seven baseline mechanism classes were repaired or disabled; targeted source review, negative tests, real MySQL and browser checks validated the active Beta controls. Remaining broad/deployment limits are explicitly deferred.

surfaces.label: Generic UI/support source outside traced workflows
surfaces.notes: Not every generic UI component, unused showcase/dashboard source, test implementation and dependency internal was fully security-audited. This is a targeted sensitive-path review with partial repository coverage, not exhaustive certification.

surfaces.label: Hosted HTTPS and Docker runtime
surfaces.notes: Local compiled server/MySQL/browser verified. Docker unavailable and public deployment prohibited; actual TLS reverse-proxy integration and hosted backup operations remain unexecuted.

surfaces.label: Portable authentication and invitation boundary
surfaces.notes: Reviewed server/auth.ts, context, cookies, trpc and startup. Replaced active legacy OAuth/JWT route with hashed opaque revocable sessions, scrypt and email-bound HMAC invitations. Registration role is fixed to user. Source and real-MySQL credential/session/expiry tests verified; placeholder invitation secret rejected.

surfaces.label: Cart, orders, addresses and notification ownership
surfaces.notes: Baseline had public appointment reads, JS && cart predicate and ID-only notification mutations. Clinical APIs now fail closed; cart SQL and notification writes include acting user; cross-user negative tests verified against actual MySQL.

surfaces.label: Inventory, checkout idempotency and cancellation
surfaces.notes: Reviewed commerce.ts and commerce-rules.ts. User/product locks, integer cents, current prescription/expiry validation, expected basket fingerprint, unique user/key and atomic order/items/stock/cart/notification transaction. Real concurrent checkout, duplicate replay, adapter fault rollback and repeated cancellation tests passed.

surfaces.label: HTTP request and browser boundary
surfaces.notes: Reviewed app.ts/http-security.ts/static/vite/systemRouter. Exact-origin JSON writes, batch/auth limits, security headers, redacted logs, body cap, loopback default and Vite host checks. Legacy OAuth callback and outbound notifyOwner are disabled. Actual Express HTTP negative tests passed.

surfaces.label: Medical and prescription services
surfaces.notes: All doctor, appointment, prescription and reminder procedures use fail-closed medicalProcedure before legacy handlers. Restricted products blocked in cart and locked checkout. No real patient information, payment or dispensing integration exercised.

surfaces.label: Checkout recovery and key preservation
surfaces.notes: Independent review identified a definitive-rejection recovery trap. Reproduced whitespace-name rejection in actual browser, added reset for BAD_REQUEST/NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN/CONFLICT while preserving keys after ambiguous failures; browser verified correction followed by successful order.

surfaces.label: Migration and local operator tooling
surfaces.notes: Reviewed schema, additive migration, preflight and seed/admin/invite scripts. Actual fresh migrations applied. A duplicate legacy cart fixture exposed Windows lowercase table-name handling; corrected and verified preflight exit1 retaining both rows. Actual dump/restore retained the fictional 8.50 JD confirmed order.

surfaces.label: Inactive provider helpers
surfaces.notes: Baseline auditor traced storage, LLM, maps, image, voice and data helpers; no active customer route invokes these. Legacy source is retained. No cloud keys or live provider calls used.
